_comment: The ONE corpus both secret detectors are tested against: bin/engram_secrets.py
(Python, used by distillation/embedding/index paths) and the engram-secrets crate
(Rust, used by engram-index and the native graph extractor). Add a sample here
and both implementations must agree on it, which is what stops them drifting.
'secret' MUST match; 'clean' MUST NOT -- the detector drives redaction and
hold-off-remote decisions, so a false positive only costs a masked hash, while a
miss sends a credential to a model endpoint.
secret: mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon ability
seed_phrase = legal winner thank year wave sausage worth
clean: the LND admin.macaroon path is ~/.lnd/...; used by lncli
seed the database with fixtures before the test run
rotate the api_key via the console, never in a memory
engram-index redacts before embedding; see engram-secrets
the recall hook fails open after 2500ms
